findings: Strict duration classification needs only the immutable marker pair plus clean-close/scheduler/failure evidence; the many intermediate checkpoints are supporting productivity/recovery evidence, not clock authority.
Future probes should reduce checkpoint count once server-clock protocol stability is established, preserving useful-work utilization and avoiding instrumentation becoming the workload itself.
This first migration probe justifies extra checkpoint density because it is simultaneously validating and repairing the new timing/control path.
